suite: Every record copies the global product's INPUT associations instead of recording PARENT → its global product; several copied EntryIds (MIANTOAC, MIANSMT, MIANLDBM, MICNFG, MIANAZM, MIANCSSC, IXBMIB2EP, IXBMIB2TP, MIB2CORR, MISANCGM) are not CMR collections; the others give versions without leading zeros (e.g. MIANCARP "2" for CMR "002") or versions CMR does not hold (e.g. MI1B2T "2"), so none resolves.
No document describes how the INTEX-B subsets were made; their provenance is visible only in the titles, abstracts and file names.
IXBMIGEO covers a different orbit set from the other five subsets.
3 linked pages return an HTTP error; 0 could not be reached from this environment.

IXBMI2AE|002: 12 existing INPUT associations copy the inputs of the global product (e.g. MIB2GEOP, MI1B2T, MI1B2E, MIRCCM, …); by rule 1c-1 they are not inputs of the subset, whose only parent is MIL2ASAE.
3 associations give a version that CMR does not hold for that ShortName: MI1B2T '2' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MI1B2E '2' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MIRCCM '3' (CMR: ['004']).

5 associations write the Version without the leading zeros CMR uses, so they do not resolve: MIB2GEOP '2' (CMR: ['002', '003']), MIANCARP '2' (CMR: ['002']), MIANCAGP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANACP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANTASC '2' (CMR: ['002']).
4 associations name ShortNames that are not CMR collections: MIANLDBM, MIANSMT, MIANTOAC, MICNFG.
